configuration.provider.description: Translation provider. When set to openai, apiBaseUrl, apiModel, and batch settings are used; when set to http, HTTP template settings such as httpEndpoint, httpHeaders, and httpBody are used (these settings remain searchable in the list).
configuration.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible service, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. The extension appends /chat/completions automatically; HTTPS is required except for local addresses.
configuration.apiModel.description: Model name used for AI translation; must be compatible with the service at apiBaseUrl.
configuration.apiThinkingMode.descriptio: Thinking mode for OpenAI-compatible services: default omits enable_thinking and uses the provider default; enabled sends enable_thinking: true; disabled sends false. Explicit modes may be rejected by providers that do not support the field.
configuration.apiThinkingMode.enumDescri: Use the provider default; do not send enable_thinking.
configuration.apiDisableThinking.descrip: Legacy switch used only when apiThinkingMode is default. Prefer apiThinkingMode.
configuration.apiBatchSize.description: Maximum number of Markdown blocks per batch (hard limit). Actual batch sizes are decided dynamically by apiBatchTokenBudget.
configuration.apiBatchTokenBudget.descri: Estimated input token budget per batch. The extension packs blocks dynamically and avoids overly small batches; the full-document summary, reference translation, and glossary consume budget based on actual content, with output counted separately. Lower this when the model has a small context or output limit.
configuration.translationConcurrency.des: Concurrency limit shared by file-level translation and batch requests within the same file. Default 8, maximum 100; lower it when the provider rate-limits or a local model is slow.
configuration.apiTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single AI request in milliseconds. On timeout the request is cancelled and existing cache is preserved.
configuration.httpEndpoint.description: Full URL of the custom HTTP translation endpoint (used only when provider is http). Supports template variables such as {{apiKey}}, {{sourceLanguage}}, and {{targetLanguage}}; HTTPS is required except for local addresses.
configuration.httpMethod.description: HTTP method for the custom translation endpoint (used only when provider is http).
configuration.httpHeaders.description: Request header JSON template (used only when provider is http). Values may use {{apiKey}}, {{sourceLanguage}}, {{targetLanguage}}, etc.; the API key is never written to settings.
configuration.httpBody.description: Request body JSON template (used only when provider is http). String values may use {{text}}, {{id}}, {{kind}}, {{headingPath}}, {{sourceLanguage}}, {{targetLanguage}}, {{apiKey}}, {{referenceText}}, {{referenceRole}}, and {{summary}}; the generic provider sends one request per block.
configuration.httpResponseType.descripti: Response type (used only when provider is http). json extracts text via httpResponsePath; text uses the response body as the translation directly.
configuration.httpResponsePath.descripti: Path to the translation field in a JSON response (used only when provider is http), for example translation, data.translations.0.text, or result[0].text.
configuration.targetLanguage.description: Target language (BCP-47, e.g. zh-CN, ja-JP). Cache and export suffixes use the primary language tag.
configuration.supportedLanguages.descrip: Candidate languages for the source/target quick switches in the task panel (BCP-47, e.g. en, zh-CN, ja-JP). Both dropdowns follow array order; blank, invalid, and case-duplicate entries are ignored, and the current sourceLanguage/targetLanguage are always included. Note: cache and export suffixes use only the primary language tag, so zh-CN and zh-TW share the zh suffix; avoid adding both.
configuration.stableTranslation.descript: Stable translation: when retranslating, the previous translation is used as a reference; when back-translating, the current source is used, reducing wording drift from small edits. Can also be toggled temporarily in the bilingual preview.
configuration.summaryContext.description: Use the manually generated document brief (summary and translation guidance) as context for sync, retranslation, and back-translation by default. Can also be toggled temporarily in the bilingual preview.
configuration.provider.enumDescription.m: Local demo translation with no network requests.
configuration.provider.enumDescription.o: Calls an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. The API key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage via a command.
configuration.provider.enumDescription.h: Calls any JSON/text HTTP endpoint with templates for headers, body, and response fields. The API key is stored in VS Code SecretStorage via a command.
